title: Bayon
visualBrief: Specific Bayon exterior: actual outer gallery compound and inner cruciform platform, a43m central stepped sanctuary, seven other mapped principal tower parts, two separately mapped eastern libraries and29 picture/layout-guided secondary tower estimates. Four-sided shallow stone face reliefs carry the identity near the camera. Open colonnades, surviving lintels, interrupted gallery roofs, cardinal approaches and terraces remain distinct. Independent nearby buildings are preserved.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Q654024/relation6990223 and standard PMTiles compound52776565123471 define the approximately121-by113m outer gallery. Inner building52776569058355 preserves its21-point cruciform platform; eight independent tower parts fix principal centers, including the19-point central sanctuary. Two mapped buildings on either side of the eastern entrance match the ordinary article’s courtyard libraries. Raw east/south coordinates preserve the almost cardinal grid and eastern approach. The ordinary modern layout picture guides secondary tower distribution within the inner cluster and at outer gopuras; its caption explicitly says the upper terrace dimensions are approximate. Tower/face inventories are not surveyed.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: The ordinary article gives a43m central tower and37 surviving towers, but does not establish an exact present inventory. The main tower retains the nominal43m top above its datum. Other tower heights, subsidiary positions, stepped crowns, damaged roof sections and facial relief are picture-guided approximations. Fine carvings, exact stone/lichen inventories, inscriptions and historical complete roofs are omitted.
